Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 2272 of 2025
Petitioner :- Smt. Sangeeta Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 7 Others Counsel for Petitioner :- Shatrughan Yadav,Vinay Kumar

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Siddharth,J.
Hon'ble Praveen Kumar Giri,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned AGA for the State-respondents.

This writ petition has been filed by learned counsel for the petitioner praying for fair investigation in Case Crime No. 0344 of 2024, under Sections 498-A, 323, 376, 377, 504, 506, 420 I.P.C. and Section 3(2) & 5 SC/ST Act, Police Station Chhatari, District Bulandshahar, with regard to the first information report dated 01.10.2024.

In case of failure, it shall be open for the petitioner to approach the Trial Court for monitoring the investigation as per judgement of the Apex Court in the case of Sakiri VasuVs. State of U.P.

opennyai_summary.decision:
This petition is disposed of directing the investigating officer to conclude the investigation within 60 days from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
In case of failure, it shall be open for the petitioner to approach the Trial Court for monitoring the investigation as per judgement of the Apex Court in the case of Sakiri VasuVs. State of U.P.
LAWS(SC)-2007-12-69.
